test_omnivore_job: run the TestOmnivoreJob test case to validate the omnivore training job with synthetic data on a single GPU
run_test_omnivore_job: execute the test_omnivore_job method to launch train_app_submitit.py with submitit cluster disabled and one GPU
test_cuda_availability: check if CUDA is available before running the omnivore job test using torch.cuda.is_available
run_training_subprocess: run the training subprocess command that launches train_app_submitit.py with swin_train_synthetic config
test_omnivision_training: test the omnivision training pipeline by running train_app_submitit.py with synthetic data and single node
